about: The pool traffic and the blocks of each node of a five-node mixed network partitioned 3 and 2 and healed (two Heartwood relays, three reference relays): every submission with the node it was sent to, its verdict there and its broadcast, every block in the order and at the time the node held it, a revert where a node left the minority's branch, and a validating collation at each slot of the node's own delegates; with the wallet listing each node served at the end.
